_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. PLACEHOLDERS ONLY - never commit real credentials. Prefer supplying email/password via the systemd EnvironmentFile (CARVA_TRACCAR_EMAIL / CARVA_TRACCAR_PASSWORD) and leaving them empty here.
_enabled: MASTER SWITCH. Must be exactly true before any command is sent. Anything else (false, missing, "true" as a string) means dry-run.
_pollIntervalMs: How often to poll Traccar for new events. Min 5000.
_lookbackOverlapMs: How far back each poll re-queries. Covers Traccar writing an event slightly after its eventTime; duplicates are filtered by event id.
_requestTimeoutMs: Hard timeout on every Traccar HTTP request.
_debounceMs: Ignore a repeat of the same (device, geofence, enter/exit) within this window. Stops GPS jitter on a fence boundary from machine-gunning relay commands. Min 1000 - it cannot be disabled.
_maxCutsPerHour: Fleet-wide rolling-hour ceiling on cut commands. Beyond it the service logs loudly and refuses. Set 0 to allow alerts but never cut.
_maxImmediateCutKmh: Above this speed an 'immediate' cut is downgraded to a safe (deferred) cut. Unknown speed also downgrades.
_maxCutEventAgeMs: A geofence crossing older than this NEVER touches the relay; the alert is still raised and flagged 'stale'. This is what stops a restart after downtime from immobilising a car for a fence it crossed hours ago. Min 60000.
_maxPositionAgeMs: A GPS fix older than this counts as 'speed unknown', so a tracker that went offline at speed cannot present its last reported 0 as proof the car is parked. Min 30000.
_maxLookbackMs: Hard floor on how far back a query window may reach, so a stuck watermark cannot grow every query without bound. Only costs late alerts - stale events cannot cut.
_alertsPath: Append-only JSONL the web app reads. One JSON object per line.
_alertsMaxBytes: Roll alerts.jsonl to alerts.jsonl.1 past this size (one generation kept). 0 disables. Keeps the audit log from filling the disk Traccar shares.
_statePath: Watermark + debounce + rate-limit state. Delete it to re-arm from now (it will NOT replay history).
